description: Use when the user asks about a specific Dutch car or licence plate, for example before buying it used: make, model, APK expiry and full inspection history with defects, insurance, open recalls, RDW odometer verdict, import/taxi/export history, specs, CO2, catalogue price and risk flags, in English. Input: Dutch licence plate. Source: RDW. Costs 0.02 USDC via x402, or 10 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.
name: nl_vehicle_report
title: Dutch vehicle report (paid)
